d:
Bihar vidhanasbha chunav men endie gathbandhan ne 202 siten jiti hain. ismen bijepi sabse bari parti aur jediyu dusre nanbar par rahi hai. vahin dusri taraph vipaksh ke mahagathbandhan ko buri tarah har ka samna karna para. ab aane vale vakt men pashchim bangal men chunav hone hain, aise men bihar chunav ke natije desh men baki jagah ki rajniti par kya asar dal sakte hain, isi par bibisi sanvaddata abhinav goyal ne bihar men maujud kuchh varishth patrakaron se bat ki.
Vidiyoh dipak jasrotiya
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
